pages.text: Find blue flowers in flower forests, sunflower plains, meadows and lush caves. Break a wild flower for the blossom and a chance at mature seeds.
Plant seeds in bright ordinary flower soil beside a plain lattice.

pages.title: Keep the Root
pages.text: The stem colonizes nearby lattice. Leave it in place so connected vines stay rooted. Shear fully flowering lattice for more blossoms. Both flowers and seeds work for $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/flower_extracts)extracts$(/l).
